name: Microgrid storage thermal-derating input
summary: Receives the declared storage operating-limit reduction associated with thermal conditions.
description: Receives the declared storage operating-limit reduction associated with thermal conditions. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Thermal limits and health” at the input and “Reduced storage capability” at the output. The resource controller determines the actual limit.
